# Dhammasaṅgaṇī-mūlaṭīkā (Tika Abh01t)
**ID:** Tika Abh01t
**Section:** Tīkā Dhammasaṅgaṇī-mūlaṭīkā (tika-abh01)
**Collection:** Tika-Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Dhammasaṅgaṇī-mūlaṭīkā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Dhammasaṅgaṇī-mūlaṭīkā* is a Pali sub-commentary (*mūlaṭīkā*) on the first book of the Abhidhammapiṭaka, the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (specifically commenting upon its commentary, the *Atthasālinī*) [Gal 2003; Ronkin 2005]. Bibliographical records also identify it under the alternative designations *Atthasālinī-mūlaṭīkā* and *Paramatthapakāsanī I* [Nyanatusita 2008]. In modern philosophical scholarship, the text is cited for its scholastic elucidations of Abhidhamma metaphysics and psychological theory; Maria Heim notes its analysis of intention (*cetanā*), where the sub-commentary defines the nature of intention (*cetanābhāva*) as "work" (*byāpāra*), characterizes its extensive duty, and compares its relation to accompanying mental factors to carefulness or respect (*ādara*) [Heim 2014]. The text has been accessed and cited via the Burmese-script Chaṭṭhasaṅgāyana edition [Nyanaponika and Bodhi 2012; Heim 2014].
There is no curated record for the text on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. Automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus registers 24,074 matching passages shared across 288 other Pali texts, while showing no cross-language matches [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual overlaps occur with closely related exegetical works, including the *Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā* (both dutiya and paṭhama volumes), the *Abhidhammāvatāra-purāṇaṭīkā*, the secondary sub-commentary *Dhammasaṅgaṇī-anuṭīkā*, the *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-ṭīkā*, and its immediate base commentary, the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus].
**Parallels and text reuse**

- Text reuse within the Pali corpus (DharmaNexus): Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā (Dutiyo bhāgo) (Anya E0104n) (§695_8–701_0 ↔ §241_1–247_0); Abhidhammāvatāra-purāṇaṭīkā (Tika Abh08t) (§463_0–464_5 ↔ §1623_7–1624_19); Dhammasaṅgaṇī-anuṭīkā (Tika Abh04t) (§99_4–99_14 ↔ §88_8–88_18); Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-ṭīkā (Tika S0201t) (§463_0–464_3 ↔ §1870_0–1871_4); Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā (Atk Abh01a) (§120_4–120_7 ↔ §858_1–858_5); Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Anya E0103n) (§336_2–337_5 ↔ §572_15–573_6); Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaabhinavaṭīkā (Paṭhamo bhāgo) (Tika S0104t) (§18_5–18_18 ↔ §488_13–490_9); Dīghanikāye Sīlakkhandhavaggaṭīkā (Tika S0101t) (§18_5–18_20 ↔ §127_0–127_15)
